Frequently Asked Questions

What is an HRMS?

An HRMS, or human resource management system, is a software application that helps organizations effectively manage their human resources. It's a comprehensive solution that combines several HR functionalities into a single, centralized platform, thereby simplifying your daily HR operations and improving efficiency.

How do I choose the best HRMS?

To keep up with the evolving world of work, it is essential to have a HR solution that not only meets your current requirements but also adapts to future challenges. Some of the important factors to consider in an HRMS include user-friendliness, integration capabilities, data security, cost, and a dedicated customer support system.

What are the key features of an HRMS?

An ideal HRMS simplifies HR work by effectively managing daily business processes while providing a positive experience for employees. Some of the key features that contribute to the overall efficiency of the organization are listed below.
- Recruitment
- Onboarding and offboarding
- Attendance and time management
- Payroll and benefits management
- Performance analysis
- Learning and development
- Document management
- Employee query management
- Reports and analytics
- Employee engagement tools

What is Zoho People?

Zoho People is a cloud-based HR software solutions from Zoho Corporation. It provides a comprehensive set of services—onboarding, time and attendance, performance, learning management, HR help desk, document management, employee engagement, and reports—to help businesses efficiently manage their HR processes. It also integrates seamlessly with other Zoho apps and third-party applications to streamline work and save time.

How do I get started with Zoho People?

Zoho People offers a 30-day free trial on all plans to help you explore the HR software. You can get started by signing up here.

What are the benefits of Zoho People?

Zoho People helps businesses of all types and sizes streamline their day-to-day HR processes on a cloud-based platform. With comprehensive HR modules, end-to-end customization, real-time automation, and seamless integrations, Zoho People aims to elevate the employee experience by building a more productive and happier workforce.

How are Zoho People licenses priced?

Zoho People has flexible, per-user pricing plans that make it a great option for businesses of every size and industry. For more details, visit our pricing page.

### What is an HRMS?

It's a comprehensive solution that combines several HR functionalities into a single, centralized platform, thereby simplifying your daily HR operations and improving efficiency.

### How do I choose the best HRMS?

Some of the important factors to consider in an HRMS include user-friendliness, [integration capabilities](https://www.zoho.com/people/integrations.html), data security, cost, and a dedicated customer support system.

### What are the key features of an HRMS?

An ideal HRMS simplifies HR work by effectively managing daily business processes while providing a positive experience for employees. Some of the key features that contribute to the overall efficiency of the organization are listed below.
- Recruitment
- Onboarding and offboarding
- Attendance and time management

### What is Zoho People?

Zoho People is a cloud-based HR software solutions from Zoho Corporation. It provides a comprehensive set of services—onboarding, time and attendance, performance, learning management, HR help desk, document management, employee engagement, and reports—to help businesses efficiently manage their HR processes. It also integrates seamlessly with other Zoho apps and third-party applications to streamline work and save time.

### How do I get started with Zoho People?

Zoho People offers a 30-day free trial on all plans to help you explore the HR software. You can get started by [signing up here](https://www.zoho.com/people/signup.html).

Zoho People helps businesses of all types and sizes streamline their day-to-day HR processes on a cloud-based platform. With comprehensive HR modules, end-to-end customization, real-time automation, and seamless integrations, Zoho People aims to [elevate the employee experience](https://www.zoho.com/people/hrknowledgehive/5-tips-to-improve-your-employee-experience.html) by building a more productive and happier workforce.

Zoho People has flexible, per-user pricing plans that make it a great option for businesses of every size and industry. For more details, visit our [pricing page](https://www.zoho.com/people/zohopeople-pricing.html).
